n: Autograph Edition 48 In. 6.0 Cu. Ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range With 7 Burner Gas Cooktop And 2 Electric Ovens In Black Stainless Steel And Polished Gold Accents
desc: The ZLINE Autograph Edition 48 in. 6.0 cu. ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range with 7 Burner Gas Cooktop and 2 Electric Ovens in Black Stainless Steel and Polished Gold Accents (RABZ-48-G) pairs a powerful gas cooktop with 7 Italian-crafted burners, a large electric convection oven, a small bake and broil oven, Landscape oven door window designs, and elegant polished gold knobs and handles. With innovative features designed to enhance your kitchen’s capability, ZLINE Legacy Dual Fuel Ranges provide a professional culinary experience by pairing unmatched performance with timeless style.
hl: The Legacy Professional Range Series represents the foundation for ZLINE’s family-focused mission of attainable luxury
Customize your ZLINE Autograph Edition Dual Fuel Range with elegant Polished Gold knob and handle accents
Optimize every meal with even heat distribution thanks to high-performance technology of a gas cooktop and a large electric convection oven
Industry-leading gas cooktop includes 7 hand-cast burners, including an expansive fish burner, with 1,000 - 18,000 BTUs of cooking power
ZLINE Legacy Series ranges feature a sleek Landscape oven door design that provides ample viewing space to ensure your dishes are perfectly cooked
A dual oven capacity of 6.0 cu. ft fits pans up to 23 in. or 9 in. wide for maximum space and convenience with everyday cooking
